name: Pho Ever Carlsbad
notes: All 3 photos are the same lit menu board (branded 'District 1 Pho'); photos 1 and 3 are identical (phone 760.472.3288, lower prices) and photo 2 shows a variant with a different phone number (760.381.6551) and higher prices for the same items — used the 1/3 pricing since it appears twice.

dishes.name: Pho Ever Chicken Wings
dishes.description: 6 wings. An Encinitas and Carlsbad favorite. Our Vietnamese version of the lemon pepper garlic wing. Tossed in our house sauce.

dishes.name: Eggrolls
dishes.description: Seasoned ground pork, carrots, jicama, and taro wrapped and fried in an egg roll shell. Served with a sweet fish sauce vinaigrette or sweet chili dipping sauce. 4 pieces.

dishes.name: O.G. Spring Rolls
dishes.description: Steamed pork, shrimp, rice vermicelli, lettuce, beansprouts and shredded mint wrapped in soft rice paper, served with our home made peanut sauce. 2 pieces.

dishes.name: Nem Nướng Spring Rolls
dishes.description: Grilled seasoned pork patty, rice vermicelli, lettuce, beansprouts, shredded mint and a fried wonton chip in soft rice paper. Served with our home made peanut sauce. 2 pieces.

dishes.name: BBQ Spring Rolls
dishes.description: Served with rice vermicelli, lettuce, beansprouts, shredded mint and a fried wonton chip wrapped in soft rice paper. Served with our home made peanut sauce. 2 pieces. Choice of BBQ Pork, BBQ Chicken, BBQ Beef, or BBQ Shrimp.
